claim: Patchline interoperates with other code-analysis tooling by exporting its migration findings into a SARIF-style interchange document and importing them back, proving the mapping is lossless for the fields that matter — rule id, severity level, message, and file location — so a finding produced by Patchline can flow into any SARIF-consuming dashboard and return without distortion. The worker emits a SARIF-like document from native findings, parses it back into native form, and checks the round-trip is field-for-field identical, while a malformed interchange document that omits a required field is rejected by the validator. The gate proves the round-trip preserves every finding exactly and that an invalid interchange document is rejected.

findings.message: Migration may hold a long lock
